title: Deleting

replies.author: SnowSX3
replies.body: Press edit, tick the archive box and press update.
replies.body_tagged: Press edit, tick the archive box and press update.

replies.author: AtditC
replies.body: Just archive it and nobody can see it then, except the staff. You can't edit it after then too.
